records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:38 — Changing the enabled category chooser while a save is pending makes the success callback display the new selection although the server persisted the earlier category.
records.rationale: In the save action, props.category_id is captured from this.get('categoryId') at save time, but the success handler later calls host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))) — re-reading categoryId at resolution time. The category-chooser input is not disabled while host.isSaving (only the save/cancel d-buttons are), so a user can change the selection during the pending request, causing the displayed category to differ from what the server persisted. Mechanism is directly verifiable in the diff lines of embeddable-host.js.es6.

records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:38 — Saving with no selected category overwrites the server's uncategorized fallback with a lookup of null and displays an incorrect empty category.
records.rationale: In the save() action, props.category_id is set from categoryId (possibly null) and after saving the component does host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))). The server's save_host falls back to SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id when blank, so the client-side lookup with null would set a wrong/empty category despite the persisted record being uncategorized — the described mechanism is verifiable in the diff.
